blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Alex Enriquez settled for the silver medal after losing to Orapa Senatham of Thailand in the women’s -63kg jiu jitsu at the Asian Games 2026 on Saturday at Aichi Prefectural Martial Arts Hall. The Thai won by an advantage for a near-pass or near-sweep after holding Enriquez down for most of their six-minute and 57-second match. Enriquez got the best finish for the Philippine jiu-jitsu team as a runner-up, although she fell short of adding to the country’s four gold medals, which matched the previous two […]...
